sequence.x: Together with the students, compile a list of good habits with regard to energy conservation.
Ask each student to make a list of these good habits and tell them to monitor their energy habits with the help of this. A sample is given below:
Energy Habit Always Do Sometime Do Never Do
Turn off the light when I leave the room
Turn off the fan when I leave the room
Cover vessel with a lid while cooking

extension.x: Discuss good habits for saving energy in the community.
